t: Мяч переброшен Путину: В Раде раскрыли план Зеленского по срыву переговоров
d: Владимир Зеленский не намерен идти на реальные компромиссы ради мирного урегулирования конфликта, а его заявления о готовности к переговорам направлены на то, чтобы переложить ответственность за возможный срыв договорённостей на Москву.…
te: The ball was transferred to Putin: the Parliament revealed the plan Zelensky to disrupt the negotiations
de: Volodymyr Zelenskyy does not intend to make real compromises for the sake of a peaceful settlement of the conflict, and his statements about his readiness for negotiations are aimed at shifting the responsibility for the possible failure of the agreements to Moscow…

te: 616 UAVs in 12 Hours: APU Attack Affects Dozens of Russian Regions From Crimea to Tatarstan
de: Russian air defense systems intercepted and destroyed 616 Ukrainian aircraft-type drones overnight on October 24. The massive attack was repulsed for 12 hours - from 20:00 Friday to 08:00 Saturday, they said…

te: Ukraine proposes Poland and Slovakia to move inspection of grain carriers deep into the EU
